title: Motion designer showreel in one sentence
prompt_text: Make a dynamic 15-second motion graphics video that shows what an incredible motion designer you are, like it's your showreel for a résumé. Go all out.

title: Brand to MP4 pipeline with Remotion
prompt_text: Make a 20-second, 1080x1920 vertical video at 30 fps. Scene 1 (0-4s): the title "<title>" types in, centered. Scene 2 (4-12s): a bar chart of <data> grows bar by bar, values counting up. Scene 3 (12-20s): one line of takeaway text, then the logo. Use only these colors: <hex list>. One font: <font>. Keep every text and number in one config object at the top, so I can change them without touching the animation code. Show me the plan first, then write the scenes, then tell me how to preview it.
skill: npx create-video --yes --blank my-video && cd my-video && npx remotion skills add
